description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) "Is there any Biblical Fact on the slavery issue of the black race?
The Hebrews were enslaved 400 yrs and according to history this is the 400th+ year. As we know the blacks from all over the world suffers prejudice and injustice more than any race under the sun, is there anything?
Thanks, God's richest blessings."
.
2.) "I am an Adventist and have a question about the 6000 years of sin. Ellen has made comments in various writings about Satan having 6000 years to work his work of deception. Following Bible given genealogy and prophecy concerning end times, we know this time frame is about exhausted. All I'm wondering is, if anywhere in the Bible I can do a study on the 6000 years of sin. Or is this a spirit of prophecy comment only?"
.
.
